payload.title: The deploy capacity gate projects a selective deploy's image pull as services x 2 GiB without the full-deploy cap, so a change to a shared library (26 services, 52 GiB) is refused although a full deploy of every image is estimated at 17 GiB and fits
evidence: scripts/deploy/droplet-capacity.sh:828 (selective estimate: service count x SERVICE_PULL_ESTIMATE_GIB, unbounded)
scripts/deploy/droplet-capacity.sh:88 (FULL_PULL_ESTIMATE_GIB 17: the worst-case pull of every image, which a subset cannot exceed)
scripts/deploy/droplet-capacity.sh:1046 (projected free = available minus the estimate, compared with the reserve)
payload.rule_violated: A selective deploy's projected pull never exceeds the full deploy's, since it pulls a subset of the same images
payload.notes: Deploy of 7a547f528 (run for #2196) refused on 2026-11-02 09:51Z: 26 services selective, 36.9 GB free, projected_free -18.9 GB against a 10 GiB reserve; safe GC reclaimed nothing (all images protected). A full-deploy estimate (17 GiB, 3 GiB reserve) passes with the same disk.
